result.instructions: Tools for Sorry, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the open incident notices for our status page."; "Review the latest public updates for incident 77."; "Find maintenance scheduled for our database components.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sorry data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sorryapp_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sorryapp_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sorryapp_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sorryapp_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sorryapp_list_pages
tools.title: List status pages
tools.description: List the status pages the API token's user can access: id, name, state (operational/degraded/...), timezone, locale, support contacts, notification channels. The id is the page_id every other tool takes. Sorry: GET /v1/pages.

tools.name: sorryapp_get_page
tools.title: Get status page
tools.description: Get one status page, optionally with related resources embedded (brand, components, custom_domain, notices, notices.updates, theme). Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}?include=...

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

include.description: Related resources to embed in the reply.

tools.name: sorryapp_list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: List a status page's components (the parts of your service shown on the page): id, name, description, state (operational/degraded/partially-degraded), position, parent_id. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/components.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

tools.name: sorryapp_get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: Get one component of a status page. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

tools.name: sorryapp_list_notices
tools.title: List notices
tools.description: List a status page's notices (incidents = type unplanned, maintenance = type planned): id, type, state, timeline_state, subject, synopsis, began/ended times, public link. Optional filters and embedded updates/components. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

state.description: Only notices in this state (planned: scheduled, cancelled, underway, complete; unplanned: investigating, identified, recovering, resolved, false_alarm).

subject_contains.description: Only notices whose subject contains this text.

created_after.description: Only notices created after this ISO 8601 date or datetime.

include.description: Embed each notice's components and/or updates.

tools.name: sorryapp_get_notice
tools.title: Get notice
tools.description: Get one notice (incident or maintenance) with its state, times and public link. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

include.description: Embed the notice's components and/or updates.

tools.name: sorryapp_list_notice_updates
tools.title: List notice updates
tools.description: List the updates (timeline comments) of one notice: id, content, should_publish, public link, times. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}/updates.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

tools.name: sorryapp_get_notice_update
tools.title: Get notice update
tools.description: Get one update of a notice. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}/updates/{update_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

tools.name: sorryapp_list_notice_templates
tools.title: List notice templates
tools.description: List the page's notice templates (reusable subject + opening comment for new incidents or maintenance): id, name, subject, initial_comment, optional component_id. Returns the vendor-default template page; paging controls are withheld pending a verified request contract. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/notice_templates.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

name_contains.description: Only templates whose name contains this text.

component_name_contains.description: Only templates scoped to a component whose name contains this text.

tools.name: sorryapp_list_update_templates
tools.title: List update templates
tools.description: List the page's update templates (reusable text for one notice update): id, name, content, optional component_id. Returns the vendor-default template page; paging controls are withheld pending a verified request contract. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/update_templates.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

name_contains.description: Only templates whose name contains this text.

component_name_contains.description: Only templates scoped to a component whose name contains this text.

tools.name: sorryapp_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List a status page's subscribers (people and channels notified of notices): id, email, phone number, name, company, tags, created time. Webhook URLs of Slack/Teams subscribers are redacted. Contains personal data. Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/subscribers.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

component_id.description: Only subscribers to this component (plus those subscribed to all components).

per_page.description: Results per page (Sorry's default for subscribers is 500).

tools.name: sorryapp_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber of a status page (personal data; webhook URLs redacted). Sorry: GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/subscribers/{subscriber_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

tools.name: sorryapp_list_timezones
tools.title: List timezones
tools.description: List the timezone names Sorry accepts for a status page (name and GMT offset label). Sorry: GET /v1/timezones.

tools.name: sorryapp_create_component
tools.title: Create component
tools.description: WRITE: add a component to a status page. It appears on the PUBLIC status page immediately, as operational. Sorry: POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/components.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

description.description: Optional text shown next to the name.

tools.name: sorryapp_update_component
tools.title: Update component
tools.description: WRITE: rename a component or change its description on the PUBLIC status page (overwrites the previous value). It cannot change the component's state: state follows open notices (use the notice tools). Sorry: PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}/components/{component_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

tools.name: sorryapp_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident notice
tools.description: WRITE: open an incident (an unplanned notice) on the status page. These changes are PUBLIC on the status page, including publish=false. publish=true additionally requests delivery to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X); vendor SMS/notification charges may apply. Confirm the content and audience first. It marks the listed components degraded on the PUBLIC page. Starts in the investigating state. Sorry: POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices with type=unplanned.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

subject.description: Incident title, e.g. API performance issues.

initial_comment.description: First update shown on the incident (public).

component_ids.description: Ids of the affected components (from sorryapp_list_components). While the notice is open they show as degraded.

publish.description: should_publish: true also sends this out to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X). Default false: sent as should_publish=false to suppress the requested broadcast. The notice/change is still public; this does not make a private draft.

tools.name: sorryapp_create_maintenance
tools.title: Create maintenance notice
tools.description: WRITE: schedule maintenance (a planned notice) on the status page. These changes are PUBLIC on the status page, including publish=false. publish=true additionally requests delivery to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X); vendor SMS/notification charges may apply. Confirm the content and audience first. Sorry: POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices with type=planned.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

initial_comment.description: First update shown on the notice (public).

begins_at_date.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (in the status page's timezone).

duration_in_minutes.description: Expected length of the maintenance in minutes.

should_automate_schedule.description: true: Sorry moves the notice to underway and complete at the scheduled times.

component_ids.description: Ids of the affected components (from sorryapp_list_components). While the notice is open they show as degraded.

publish.description: should_publish: true also sends this out to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X). Default false: sent as should_publish=false to suppress the requested broadcast. The notice/change is still public; this does not make a private draft.

tools.name: sorryapp_update_notice
tools.title: Update notice
tools.description: WRITE: change a notice: its subject, state (for example resolved), affected components, schedule, and/or add a comment (an update) to its timeline. These changes are PUBLIC on the status page, including publish=false. publish=true additionally requests delivery to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X); vendor SMS/notification charges may apply. Confirm the content and audience first. Fields you pass overwrite the previous values. Sorry: PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

state.description: New state. Planned: scheduled, cancelled, underway, complete. Unplanned: investigating, identified, recovering, resolved, false_alarm.

additional_comment.description: A new public update to add to the notice timeline. publish controls the requested subscriber/integration broadcast; false still changes the public page.

component_ids.description: Ids of the affected components (from sorryapp_list_components). While the notice is open they show as degraded.

begins_at_date.description: Planned notices only: new start date YYYY-MM-DD.

begins_at_time.description: Planned notices only: new start time HH:MM:SS.

duration_in_minutes.description: Planned notices only: new duration in minutes.

publish.description: should_publish: true also sends this out to subscribers and integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X). Default false: sent as should_publish=false to suppress the requested broadcast. The notice/change is still public; this does not make a private draft.

tools.name: sorryapp_create_notice_update
tools.title: Add notice update
tools.description: WRITE: add one update (a comment) to a notice's timeline. It is PUBLIC on the status page, and Sorry's docs say a new update is also published to the page's configured integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X). The docs list no switch to suppress that on this endpoint, so confirm_publish=true is required; this endpoint has no exposed suppression switch. Sorry: POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}/updates.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm_publish.description: Must be true. Confirms you understand the update is published on the PUBLIC status page and pushed to subscribers and configured integrations (email, SMS, Slack, Teams, X): Sorry's docs offer no way to add an update without that.

tools.name: sorryapp_edit_notice_update
tools.title: Edit notice update
tools.description: WRITE: rewrite the text of an existing notice update on the PUBLIC status page (overwrites the previous text; the old text is not kept). Sorry: PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}/notices/{notice_id}/updates/{update_id}.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

tools.name: sorryapp_create_subscriber
tools.title: Add one subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add ONE subscriber (an email address and/or a phone number) to a status page. From then on that person is emailed/texted about notices published on the page, and Sorry may send them a confirmation. Add only people who asked to be notified. No bulk import. Sorry: POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/subscribers.

page_id.description: The status page id, e.g. 12ab34cd (from sorryapp_list_pages).

confirm.description: Set true only after the user approved this public status change or subscriber addition and any requested notification.

phone_number.description: Phone number with the international country code, e.g. +441234567890.

component_ids.description: Subscribe to only these components (default: all components).
